title: Evidence for Chapter 26: war finance, reparations, money demand and the 1923 stabilization
source: Keynes (1919, 1929); Ohlin (1929) and Keynes reply; Bresciani-Turroni (1937); Sargent (1982); Reichsgesetzblatt (1923); institutional biographies and archives
series: Evidence snippets: id, place, year, values (; separated), unit, bibliography key, print page/section, exact source text, note
license: Public-domain original documents (1919/1923/1929); short evidentiary extracts from Bresciani-Turroni (1937, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED) and Sargent (1982), for criticism, scholarship and teaching; no full original is redistributed. Data transcriptions are factual subsets. Wikisource transcription CC BY-SA; archival and museum statements are cited facts. Translations in the chapter are the authors’.
notes: Primary articles are checked in original journal issues. Helfferich and Luther voices and Young data via Bresciani/Sargent are identified as indirect testimony. See source text for OCR errors; values are separately read and checked. No general-equilibrium or causal estimate is inferred from monetary ratios.
